about: The full player's stacked open and close in Max on a portrait window (the owner's 1080 x 1872 screen), in every skin (each shot sets the skin itself and puts Cyber back: a shot look would change the theme, which his Live Theming rule holds): fade (Vanilla, Glass, Ocean) or slide (Press, Cyber). Checks that nothing is left held or copied after each motion, and a close during the open.
pass: Each probe's expect holds. In the log: player max open / close dropped under 3 %, worst under 17 ms. In the strips: no content card at a new size or place, the Queue never jumps, nothing moves after the open lands, and the close ends with no jump.
run: node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/fp-stack.json   (needs `npm run dev:app` running, its window maximized on a portrait screen)

steps.probe: JSON.stringify({ full: window.__full.state().full, stack: document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-fp-stack'), side: document.documentElement.dataset.fpHistory ?? null, stills: document.querySelectorAll('.fp-still').length, queueOpacity: document.querySelector('.panel[data-slot="queue"]').style.opacity })
steps.name: open
